assets.asset_type: Property - Condo, The Coralis, Sentosa Cove (own residence)
Private business - 100% of Lim Precision Trading Pte Ltd

sow_declaration: My wealth comes from my salary and dividends as the founder and Managing Director of Lim Precision Trading Pte Ltd, which I started in 2011 with SGD 100,000 of my own savings from my years as a sales manager. The company distributes industrial machine parts to manufacturers in Singapore. I also own two residential properties in Singapore which have increased in value and one of which earns rental income. I have no other business interests and all my income is declared in Singapore.
notes: Not declared: the client is the 100% ultimate beneficial owner of Arcadia Holdings Ltd (British Virgin Islands) through Seaview Ventures Ltd (Seychelles), but the KYC form says he has no other shareholdings or directorships (08_Certificate_of_Incumbency_Arcadia_Holdings.pdf, 01_KYC_Onboarding_Form_Marcus_Lim.pdf).
